item.title: Hello 1.0.4
item.description:
Hello 1.0.4

  • A new Hello icon, in the app, the menu bar and the Dock.
  • 12 new recording indicators, 17 in all. Wave is now the default.
  • Place the indicator at the top or bottom, and on the left, in the center or on the right. Click a spot on the new screen map in Appearance.
  • Rounded corners are now clean everywhere.
  • Hello is now open source: the code, releases and website are at github.com/dhruba-datta/hello.
